STYLE: High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. A refined adult anime face drawn to her own FACE line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Highly detailed clothing and accessories with convincing fabric weave, stitching, folds, seams, buckles and material-specific reflections. Combine stylized anime facial features with richly rendered dimensional clothing. Use luminous midtones, restrained highlights on clothing and armor, and a delicate pastel palette. Her skin has a glossy sheen — smooth, bright specular highlights on her shoulders, collarbones, chest, arms and thighs, a polished lustrous finish over her skin tone, never wet or oily. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

SUBJECT: A female mecha personification character with Primeape as her motif — the creature reimagined as an armored adult woman, not a mascot costume or a creature suit: her plates, undersuit, hair and ornaments carry its palette, markings and shapes. She wears its features as costume; nothing is carried, mounted or put on display. Her skin is human skin.

WEAR: the triangular ears become a headpiece or hair ornament of the same shape.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): oval face, balanced length, wide width; wide heavy chin; narrow eyes, small size, level outer corners, average spacing; short rounded brows; rounded soft tip nose; wide mouth.

IMPRESSION (reads even at card size): a fierce, combative woman in her mid-twenties; a sharp, narrow-eyed glare; warm hazel eyes; a crisp winged eyeliner.

FORM — LIGHT: one layer of thin, close-fitting hard armor that covers most of her body: a chest plate joined to segmented abdominal plates down to her hips, shoulder pauldrons, upper-arm and forearm plates with gauntlets, hip and thigh plates, knee guards, shin guards and armored boots; the fitted undersuit shows only in narrow gaps at the joints, joints free. The plates stay thin and close to her body, so the outline is slim and readable without slimming her figure. No helmet; at most a slim headband or temple sensor.

ARMOR: rigid hard-surface mecha armor — solid plates of enamelled metal and ceramic with visible thickness, bevelled edges, layered rims, panel lines, seams, small vents, sensor lights and mechanical joints, casting real shadows onto the undersuit. The plates sit on top of her body as separate machined parts, never printed or painted onto fabric, never a patterned bodysuit.

MECHA SILHOUETTE: separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit showing between them. Solid hard-surface plates that read as armor, not cloth.

TYPE EFFECTS: One open hand conjuring a hot orange aura of force amid pulsing rings of raw force. Her whole silhouette is outlined by a hot orange aura of force, clearly visible as a bright rim of light along her body and armor. A light trail of pulsing rings of raw force streams back from her heels and back armor.

EXPOSURE: armor and undersuit open by design only at a deep neckline window with cleavage, and bare upper thighs; everywhere else fully covered. Plates stay on and symmetrical; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered.

OUTPUT: one dynamic action image that is also this form's card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion. Camera level with her face; her body and face turned gently three-quarters toward the camera (never a back view), her head level with her chin neither raised nor tucked, no upward perspective on her face. Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.

IDENTITY (chosen details override the automatic look)
body type: an hourglass figure with a subtly full bust, a slim waist and very wide, curvy rounded hips that flow smoothly into softly full thighs, the line tapering gradually toward the knees with no sudden narrowing below the hips, and slender lower legs — never thick or heavy
body scope: Body type sets the build; body details adjust within it. These describe anatomy beneath armor, not equipment volume.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions — about 7.5 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. No extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Keep both hands relaxed — a loose fist, an open palm or resting on something. Gloves are full-finger and close-fitting; plates, water, sparks and effects stay off the fingers.
